page.overview:
Who is Unnamed Descendant of Stilgar?

A fifth-generation descendant of Stilgar, the famous Fremen Naib, lived during the time of the God Emperor Leto Atreides II, unaware of his ancestry. He sat on a bench in Arrakeen for half a day, waiting for someone.

He did not notice Leto himself watching him, and Leto noted that Stilgar would have known it in a second or two. Eventually, the man got up and walked off. Leto was able to tell he was near the end of his life. He wore an antique Stillsuit and had gray hair and cracked lips.

Category:Characters
